test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"huge"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• If you want to describe **something that is incredibly large,** use the term **huge**.
 
• According to the passage, **clothing, language, religion, food, rituals,** and even music all play a **significant part **in defining a **person's culture.**
 
• Therefore, the correct word for blank 1) is **huge**.
